verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a self-hosted deployment mode: a single binary that runs on any machine, bare metal or containers. That lets users keep data wherever they run it. A community user also implies Meilisearch Cloud offers selectable regions such as Singapore, but no first-party docs describe cloud region choice or residency guarantees. Missing for 10: first-party docs on Cloud region selection and the list of available regions, data-residency or compliance commitments, and coverage of regions such as Australia.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
They wish the cloud had an Australian region, since the closest is Singapore.
A self-hoster runs ~80M documents (191GB, 13 indexes) on a 64GB Hetzner box
